title: Business Development Executive
description:
This position has now been filled. If you are interested in this type of vacancy moving forward, please do send your CV across for the future

R13 are currently recruiting for a Business Development Executive to join a growing sales team, playing an important role in converting warm, inbound interest into genuine sales opportunities. With this position, there s no cold calling involved. You ll be working with warm leads from B2 B clients who have actively expressed an interest, whether through a website enquiry, marketing activity or previous engagement with the business.

This role has been created as a development route into a more senior consultative sales position, giving you the opportunity to build your product knowledge, develop your sales skills and learn the business before progressing into a full specialist Business Development role. It s designed to be an opportunity for someone who has the right sales ability but may not yet have the depth of the company s specialist product knowledge needed to step straight into a senior-level position.

Salary is offered at £26,750 with realistic OTE of £45,000 at this starting-level position OTE increasing significantly as you progress into the more senior role. Monday-Friday 9-5 hours, based in central Norwich offices.

The Company

Our client is a well-established and growing specialist business with a strong reputation in its market. The sales team is continuing to develop, with a real focus on bringing ambitious sales people into the business and giving them the training and support to build a successful career.

You ll be joining a collaborative sales environment where the team work closely together, share knowledge and support one another to convert inbound opportunities into new business.

Benefits
- Clear progression route into a specialist sales role with increased OTE.
- Office-based during probation, with up to 2 days working from home thereafter.
- 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.
- Additional day off for your birthday.
- Bupa healthcare plan.
- Statutory pension.
- Free parking (limited spaces)
- Central city based location
- Supportive, collaborative sales environment.
- Structured training and ongoing product development.

The Day-to-Day
- Manage a portfolio of warm, inbound enquiries, ensuring potential customers receive a great first impression.
- Speak with prospective clients to understand their requirements, motivations, timescales and what they are looking to achieve.
- Ask the right questions to qualify opportunities and establish whether the business can provide the right solution.
- Build rapport quickly and have confident, consultative conversations with prospective customers.
- Schedule qualified appointments with the senior members of the team.
- Work towards agreed targets around lead qualification, appointments booked and appointments attended.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, including lead information, qualification notes and appointment outcomes.
- Follow up with prospects where appropriate and keep opportunities moving through the early stages of the sales process.
- Build your product and industry knowledge through structured training, hands-on experience and working alongside experienced salespeople.

You Will Have / Be
- Previous experience in sales, business development, appointment setting or lead qualification role.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.
- Comfortable asking questions, listening properly and getting to the heart of what a business actually needs.
- Commercially minded, with a genuine interest in developing your sales ability.
- Target-driven and motivated by achieving results.
- Organised and confident managing a busy pipeline of enquiries.
- Resilient and able to handle a high volume of conversations without losing quality.
- Naturally curious and keen to build your knowledge of a new product and industry.
- Ambitious, with an interest in progressing into a more senior consultative sales position.

How to Apply

To hear more details about this fantastic opportunity, please email your CV to Rebecca Headden Business Partner at R13 Recruitment. If you don't hear from us within 5 working days of submitting your application, please assume you have been unsuccessful on this occasion.

For candidates applying from outside the local region, please include a brief covering note outlining your relocation plans, current location, and anticipated timeframe for moving. Applications without this information may not be considered further.

title: Group Sales Consultant
company: Select Recruitment Specialists Ltd - Agency - Permanent
salary_text: £28000 - £30000 per year (Plus Excellent Commission and Benefi)
description:
Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant - Norwich, Norfolk - Salary Competitive

My client is a well-established, privately owned leisure and hospitality business expanding their dedicated group holidays division, seeking a Sales Consultant with travel or tourism experience to join a team genuinely passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team within a respected, four-decade heritage business where your travel industry expertise as a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant will directly shape customer journeys and build lasting client relationships.

As a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant, you'll have the opportunity to proactively identify and approach new client prospects whilst nurturing and growing existing relationships through understanding their unique requirements and designing tailored group travel packages. You'll manage incoming enquiries from initial contact through to confirmation and booking, research and negotiate accommodation and services with hotels and suppliers, and develop detailed, personalised itineraries that bring group travel experiences to life. Working towards agreed sales targets, you'll create engaging promotional materials, handle payment processing, undertake occasional travel for client visits and supplier meetings, and contribute to the continued growth of the group holidays division giving you genuine variety, real customer impact, and the satisfaction of crafting memorable travel experiences as a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant.

This Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant role would suit someone with a background in travel, tourism, or hospitality who brings confident, persuasive communication with strong negotiation ability. You'll be highly organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, and possess a genuine passion for travel and delivering outstanding customer experiences. Your self-starter mindset, travel industry knowledge, and enthusiasm for understanding client needs will help you thrive in this customer-focused role.

What you'll enjoy as part of the package:
- Competitive salary
- Full-time position (part-time considered for the right candidate)
- Opportunity to join a growing team with a great customer attitude
- Varied, customer-facing role with genuine impact

My client is a well-established, privately owned leisure and hospitality business with over four decades of heritage and a strong reputation as one of Britain's foremost operators in the holiday market. Headquartered in a prestigious listed building in Norwich with offices in Yorkshire and Scotland, they offer a diverse portfolio spanning UK domestic breaks, escorted overseas holidays, rail journeys, ocean cruises, and European river cruises. Their loyal customer base shares genuine enthusiasm for travel, and their team shares a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences making this an ideal environment for a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant with travel industry experience who values both customer satisfaction and genuine team culture.

If this Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant opportunity sounds like the right next step for you, get in touch with Select Recruitment today to find out more.

title: Insurance Customer Service Representative
company: Service Service Employment Agency Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
My client is a local insurance broker specialising in holiday home insurance as well as other insurance products, including Landlord, Home, and Caravans. They offer their customers their personal expertise in providing the best quotes for their insurance requirements.

My client is looking for a new member of staff to join their existing close-knit team, based just outside of the centre of Norwich.

Job summary

To provide customers with a welcoming, efficient, professional and effective customer service experience, with a high focus on quality and accuracy, adhering to FCA guidelines and TCF principles at all times.

Key responsibilities
- You will obtain appropriate information to ensure products are offered to meet both customer demands and needs.
- You will issue policy documents within regulatory timeframes, including new business, renewals, cancellations and Mid Term Adjustments (MTAs).
- You will underwrite policies within your delegated authority, referring to in-house and external underwriters as required for more complex areas of business.
- You will work as part of the team to manage the 'renewal' and 'new business' diary.
- You will respond to customer enquiries via telephone, email and post in a timely manner.
- You will manage objections, including policy cancellations, premium increases and claims decisions.
- You will manage customer complaints in a professional and efficient manner, referring details to compliance on receipt.
- You will record and maintain accurate customer information, ensuring records are accurately and efficiently updated.
- You will process payments including renewals, new business and MTAs.
- You will maintain required levels of competence and standards of performance.
- You will work as part of the customer service team to meet team objectives by securing and retaining business.

Qualifications

GCSE grade A-C or 9-4 in Maths and English

Hold or working towards Level 3 Certificate in Insurance (Desirable)

Experience

Minimum of 1 year's general insurance sales experience (Desirable)

Knowledge and skills
- Understanding of FCA rules, ethics and financial regulations
- Previous experience working in a phone based environment
- Working knowledge of property insurance products (Desirable)
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- Professional phone manner
- Strong customer service skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accurate record keeping
- Effective questioning and listening skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Problem solving skills
- Ability to work to deadlines
- Strong IT skills

Basic Salary of £24,000 and reviewed after successful 6 month probation - negotiable depending on experience, Monthly bonus up to an additional £100 p/m

Annual bonus

Holiday starting at 21 days + bank holidays, rising with length of service up to 27 days + bank holidays

Hybrid working once trained/competent for the role (1 day at home and 4 days office) following training and a successful probation period

Working hours -week 1 - 8:30am - 5:00pm Week 2 9:30am - 6:00pm, rolling shift pattern

10% employer contribution (employee does not have to contribute)

4 times death in service

BUPA cash plan (medical expenses)

Free parking
